requirements.statement: Every active accepted requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Conformance correspondence declaring applicability mechanical or none.
Every mechanically applicable requirement SHALL resolve through its canonical correspondence to at least one executable assertion with stable assertion identity.
FS0 Conformance SHALL use assertion, support, evidence, and orchestration as its only required top-level primitive roles.
Assertion identity SHALL remain distinct from implementation-callable identity.
Every maintained Conformance primitive SHALL resolve to accepted normative authority.
Every executable assertion SHALL produce or resolve the evidence required by FS0 Conformance authority.
Every gating assertion SHALL be reachable from authorized canonical Conformance execution.
FS0 Conformance evidence SHALL demonstrate conforming-state acceptance, targeted-violation rejection, and execution of required assertions.
FS0 SHALL provide one canonical remotely runnable Conformance surface through GitHub Actions.
Before cutover, execution of candidate Conformance machinery SHALL be bootstrap mechanical verification evidence only.
Each installed Conformance correspondence record SHALL contain requirement_id, applicability, and assertion_ids.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, canonical Conformance execution SHALL use the repository GitHub Actions workflow.
Multiple assertions MAY share one implementation only when assertion identities and provenance remain distinct.
FS0 SHALL provide one machine-resolvable canonical repository Conformance execution entry point invoked by the fixed FS0 GitHub workflow.
After cutover, the accepted Conformance execution surface SHALL be canonical unless later changed through Governance.
A Conformance correspondence with applicability mechanical SHALL contain at least one stable assertion identity.
A Conformance correspondence with applicability none SHALL contain an empty assertion_ids collection.
Conformance evidence in the fixed FS0 GitHub binding SHALL be a workflow or check result tied to the exact candidate commit SHA.
Every generated FS0 read surface SHALL be reproducible from its declared canonical maintenance inputs and identified generation implementation.
Canonical Conformance SHALL compare generated FS0 read surfaces with deterministic regeneration from their declared canonical source inputs.
